component.name: JoyToggle
component.summary: Enable or disable joystick devices without unplugging

description.p: JoyToggle lets you bind and unbind joystick, throttle, rudder, and other HID game controllers at the kernel level — no unplugging required.
Built for sim pilots running HOTAS setups who need to switch between different controller configurations or temporarily disable devices without touching the hardware.

ul.li: Toggle individual devices on or off with a single click
Enable All / Disable All for quick profile switching
Persistent state across reboots — devices restore to their last state on boot
Auto-detects device type (joystick, throttle, rudder pedals, gamepad)
Hide auto-detected clutter (keyboards mis-detected as HID devices)
Live auto-refresh when devices are plugged or unplugged

description.p: Uses a D-Bus system daemon with polkit authentication — no passwordless sudo, no persistent root process in your session.
Initial release of the Rust rewrite.

ul.li: Complete rewrite from Python/GTK4 to Rust with a GPUI frontend
D-Bus system daemon replaces pkexec — polkit authentication, no persistent root process
Hidden devices section with user-controlled and auto-hide
